lines.trans: How did the talk with your father go?
My father said he went to the auto repair shop...
He said the estimate came out to eight hundred thirty thousand won...
Oh no, it's not that your father was ripped off...
Ah, yes. I will ask my father once again.
Yeah, ask him. Now that you took off the suit, you really look like a rookie.
You dressed well. Hey, you have something on you here.
Thank you.
When you hear from your father, text me.
You know my number, right?
Yes, I know it.
Yeah. If you have any difficulties, tell me.
Good work.
